title: Learning Acceptable Lotteries via Queries: Minimizing Aggregated Violation Distances
abstract: arXiv:2611.29555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When deploying an AI system, a developer can randomize over several candidate versions, sending each request to a version chosen at random, to balance the requirements of multiple stakeholders. We study a setting in which each of $n$ stakeholders reveals only whether a proposed lottery over $m$ candidates is acceptable, and each stakeholder's acceptable lotteries lie on one side of an unknown hyperplane. While previous work sought a lottery that every stakeholder accepts, such a lottery need not exist when, for instance, safety and helpfulness requirements are in conflict. We therefore minimize a power mean of the stakeholders' violations; since binary answers reveal neither the size of a violation nor how to compare violations across stakeholders, we measure each violation by a normalized distance to the stakeholder's acceptance boundary. translated_title: 通过查询学习可接受的彩票（随机分配方案）：最小化聚合违反距离
translated_abstract: 在部署AI系统时，开发者可以在多个候选版本之间进行随机化，将每个请求发送给随机选出的版本，以平衡多个利益相关者的需求。我们研究这样一个场景：$n$个利益相关者中的每一个仅揭示其对由$m$个候选者构成的某个彩票（随机分配方案）是否可接受，且每个利益相关者可接受的彩票都位于某个未知超平面的一侧。以往的工作寻求一个所有利益相关者都接受的彩票，但当例如安全性与有用性要求相互冲突时，这样的彩票未必存在。因此，我们最小化各利益相关者违反程度的幂平均；由于二元（接受/拒绝）回答既无法揭示违反程度的大小，也无法揭示如何在利益相关者之间比较违反程度，我们用该利益相关者到其接受边界的归一化距离来度量每个违反程度。我们精确刻画了接受/拒绝回答何时能够确定这些距离。（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 当不存在能让所有利益相关者都接受的AI候选方案时，本文提出仅通过接受/拒绝查询学习各方未知的接受边界，以各方归一化违反距离的幂平均作为度量并最小化总体违反，从而学习出最可接受的候选方案随机分配。
en_tdlr: When no lottery satisfies all stakeholders, this paper learns, using only accept/reject queries, a lottery that minimizes the power mean of stakeholders' normalized violation distances to their unknown acceptance boundaries.
